items.title: 6.4.1.3 Peer-to-Peer Network and Its Usage in Blockchain (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of P2P networks (PDF 163).

blocks.title: Peer-to-peer (P2P) network
blocks.text: P2P network mein computers (nodes) baghair markazi server ke ek doosre se seedha baat aur wasail share karte hain; har node client aur server dono hota hai.

File-sharing network mein users file ke hisse ek saath kai doosre users ke computers se seedha download karte hain, jo ek markazi server se tez aur behtar hai. Blockchain mein nodes transactions aur blocks seedha ek doosre ko dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Blockchain mein P2P networks ka kirdar bataiye (short question 1). In ka bunyadi kaam kya hai (MCQ 16)?
blocks.explanation: (c) baghair markazi server ke nodes ke darmiyan seedha data share karna. Har node naye transactions aur blocks leta aur aage bhejta, ledger ki poori copy rakhta aur blocks ko qawaid par jaanchta hai. Markazi server na hone se aik nuqte ki nakami ya qaboo nahi, kuch nodes kharab hon to bhi network chalta hai, aur kai copies chhed-chhaar ko pakarne ke qabil banati hain.

items: P2P: nodes seedha share karte, har ek client aur server; blockchain ki reerh ki haddi.
